sources.title: Ling-3.0-flash-Fin configuration
sources.evidence: Direct raw file read succeeded: BailingMoeV3ForCausalLM, bailing_hybrid, 42 layers, 512 routed experts, 8 selected per token, 1 shared expert, 2 initial dense layers, KDA settings, max_position_embeddings 262144, one next-token prediction layer, and untied token embeddings.

sources.title: Ling-3.0-flash-Fin chat template
sources.evidence: Public template accepts textual messages, defaults thinking to on, preserves reasoning_content, and serializes tools, function calls, arguments and tool responses.

sources.title: Ling-3.0-flash model architecture overview
sources.evidence: The parent architecture, explicitly shared by Fin in its own card, is hybrid-linear MoE: 35 Kimi Delta Attention layers plus 7 gated MLA layers, in a 5:1 arrangement. This source is used only for the architecture that Fin explicitly inherits.

sources.title: Ling-3.0-flash-Fin and FinFIRST open release
sources.evidence: Dated 2026-09-04, announces Fin weights and FinFIRST openly released, describes 124B A5.1B MoE with approximately 256K context, and links the public exact-model Hugging Face and ModelScope repositories.

sources.title: Ling-3.0-flash-Fin repository history
sources.evidence: Repository history shows initial commit and weight uploads on 2026-09-03, separating checkpoint publication from the earlier API announcement.

sources.title: Exact Fin checkpoint implementation at audited revision
sources.evidence: BailingMoeV3Gate registers expert_bias as a buffer. KDA A_log and dt_bias are learned Parameters. The constructor builds 42 backbone layers and one auxiliary BailingMoeV3MTPLayer, indexed 42. MTP reuses model.word_embeddings and lm_head. Config tie_word_embeddings=false leaves those two matrices distinct despite the class-level potential-tie key.

sources.title: Exact Fin checkpoint tensor index and bounded shard-header reconciliation
sources.evidence: Independently fetched all 65 shard headers using bounded HTTP 206 ranges, covering every one of 63783 indexed tensors at unchanged revision a5b4afb48f526175991724472c179e5a065604de. Summed shapes yield 127486405600 elements; subtract 41 expert_bias buffers totaling 20992 to obtain 127486384608 learned parameters. Header bytes match the index total_size 254973142144; no quantization tensors or overlapping storage ranges occur.

sources.title: Exact Fin auxiliary MTP shard header
sources.evidence: Only the 8-byte length prefix and 193664-byte JSON header were downloaded. Layer 42 contains 3072194048 stored elements, including one 512-element expert_bias buffer, hence 3072193536 learned auxiliary parameters. Remaining learned backbone is 124414191072. No duplicate embedding/head tensors are stored in the auxiliary shard.

release_date.note: Earliest verified public introduction is the official August 27 UTC post. August 28 is the Chinese blog date; September 3 weight upload and September 4 open-release article are later milestones.

parameters_b.note: Exact complete-checkpoint learned count: 127,486,384,608 = 124,414,191,072 backbone + 3,072,193,536 auxiliary MTP. Excludes 20,992 registered expert_bias buffer elements; retains learned F32 A_log/dt_bias. Untied input/output matrices count once each; MTP reuses them. Official 124B is the nominal backbone scale, not the full checkpoint total.

active_parameters_b.note: Official 5.1B activated figure for Fin, retained as nominal. The source does not define a complete-checkpoint or speculative-decoding phase convention; no active count is inferred from the full learned total or from routing alone.

architecture.note: Hybrid-linear MoE, with KDA and gated MLA in a 5:1 arrangement. Fin explicitly inherits Flash architecture; its own configuration corroborates expert routing. The catalog label moe retains this distinction in notes.

context_window.note: Exact Fin max_position_embeddings is 262144, resolving the nominal 256K context notation.

modalities.note: Text-generation causal language model and textual chat serialization; no vision/audio encoders or multimodal input handling are declared in this exact checkpoint.

reasoning.note: Exact template supports thinking control and reasoning_content, enabling thinking by default.

tool_call.note: Exact template implements function definitions, tool_call serialization, arguments and tool responses; the official launch documents financial tool use.

description.value: Finance-enhanced model for financial research, multi-step investment workflows, and long-horizon planning and execution
description.note: Supported as intended uses by the exact-model announcement, rather than a claim of guaranteed financial accuracy.

sources.label: Fin learned parameters and buffer implementation

patch.notes: The full BF16 checkpoint contains 127,486,384,608 unique learned parameters: 124,414,191,072 backbone plus 3,072,193,536 auxiliary MTP. All 65 shard headers were counted; 20,992 registered routing expert_bias buffer elements were excluded. F32 KDA A_log and dt_bias are learned parameters and remain included. Input embeddings and lm_head are explicitly untied, each counted once; MTP reuses both without extra copies. The official 124B total is a nominal backbone label. The official 5.1B activated figure is retained as nominal, with no inferred MTP/decoding-phase count. Architecture is hybrid-linear MoE with KDA and gated MLA in a 5:1 arrangement. Initial public introduction was August 27, 2026 UTC; checkpoint uploads followed September 3, with the open-weight announcement September 4.

summary: All 14 fields verified. Reconciled the exact Fin checkpoint independently: 127.486384608B complete learned parameters, comprising 124.414191072B backbone and 3.072193536B auxiliary MTP; excluded 20,992 routing-buffer elements. Preserved source-defined nominal 5.1B active and documented nominal 124B backbone. Confirmed hybrid-linear MoE, MIT public BF16 weights, and August 27 initial release separately from September weight publication.
